Kristin Fisher's dirty weekend with Rich Lister ex after split from toyboy... Plus, brutal sacking of 'legend' trainer sparks chaos at Barry's Bootcamp: THE GROUP CHAT

A beloved trainer's exit sparks fresh whispers, and leaked screenshots, from the crumbling castle of Barry's Bootcamp, while eastern suburbs trainwreck Kristin Fisher finds herself back in familiar company.

Actual Article Body:
By LUCY MANLY, SENIOR NEWS REPORTER, AUSTRALIA

Published:  00:57 AEST, 25 September 2026   |  Updated:  01:03 AEST, 25 September 2026

Welcome to The Group Chat with Lucy Manly, where Australia's most trusted society insider shares the hottest gossip before it makes the news.

On-again, off-again lovers - or whatever we're calling them this week - publican Stu Laundy and eastern suburbs trainwreck Kristin Fisher appear to have found their way back into each other's orbit, spending AFL preliminary final weekend in close quarters.

Several sources claim Fisher, who split from 28-year-old toyboy Shannon Sykes only recently, was in Laundy's company before turning up at the Sydney Swans v Fremantle Dockers clash at the SCG in rather high spirits.

It was a disappointing night for the Bloods, with WA gal Fisher's favourite team besting them by 12 points to secure a ticket to the grand final.

The Laundy family - one of Australia's most prominent Rich Lister dynasties - are known to be 'mad Swannies fans', but we imagine Fisher helped smooth over any wounds that night after Stu's team was knocked out.

Sources tell me eastern suburbs trainwreck Kristin Fisher (pictured) was in Stu Laundy's company before turning up at the Swans v Dockers clash at the SCG in rather high spirits

The pair have long maintained they are 'good friends', with Laundy regularly treating Fisher (pictured in 2024) and her children to dinners during periods when she has been doing it tough

Sources say Fisher enjoys the company of wealthy men - which would certainly make Laundy (pictured with a friend at his 50th birthday in 2022) a handy side-piece

The pair have long maintained they are 'good friends', with Laundy understood to have met Fisher's parents during a trip to Broome, as well as regularly treating Fisher and her children to dinners during periods when she has been doing it tough.

And while those close to the pair insist there is unlikely to be anything official on the cards, one source described it as a fairly uncomplicated arrangement for Laundy: low effort, no strings and none of the tiresome admin that comes with an actual girlfriend.

As for Fisher - who appears to be keeping her options open romance-wise, if her cosy pub date with Chris Hemsworth's stunt double, Bobby Holland Hanton, is anything to go by - sources say she enjoys the company of wealthy men (wow).

Which, if true, would certainly make Laundy, whose family now owns 2GB, 3AW, 4BC and 6PR, a rather handy person to have in her contacts list.

Haven't we learnt by now to read the room before commenting on social media?

Celebrity hairstylist Christopher Hunter recently took to Instagram to share the devastating news that his newborn son with partner Pala Negara had died.

'Harmony Hunter came in like an angel and left a mark on us forever. 28/08/2026,' he wrote in the raw and deeply personal post.

Celebrity hairstylist Christopher Hunter recently took to Instagram to share the news that his newborn son with partner Pala Negara had died

Bernadette Fahey misread it entirely, commenting: 'Congrats. I'm so happy for you guys'

Hunter went on to describe how his son's death had 'solidified us as a couple, as a family and shown us what we are truly capable of together'.

'Our love has blossomed into a truly unstoppable force that can only come from the deep grief we have been through together,' he wrote.

He also revealed that he spent Father's Day digging Harmony's grave alongside a group of men who cared for the family.

'We cried and built a bond that will last a lifetime,' he wrote.

Such a heartbreaking post would, you would think, be difficult to mistake for a celebratory announcement. But sadly, not everyone made it that far into the caption.

Pilates queen Bernadette Fahey appeared to misread it entirely, commenting: 'Congrats. I'm so happy for you guys.'

Her comment has since disappeared, thankfully.
